title: Publication 15-B (2026), Employer's Tax Guide to Fringe Benefits

passages.question: Does Publication 15-B treat health coverage through the cafeteria plan as exempt from FUTA?
passages.excerpt: A cafeteria plan, including an FSA, provides participants an opportunity to receive qualified benefits on a pre-tax basis. ... Accident and health benefits Exempt (except 2% shareholder-employees of S corporations). Exempt Exempt
